definitions.explanation: The natural agent that makes things visible; brightness from the sun, a lamp, etc.
Used metaphorically to represent hope or a positive outlook.

examples.japanese: {太陽|たいよう}の{光|ひかり}が{眩|まぶ}しい。

examples.english: A light became visible. / I can see hope.

notes:
{光|ひかり} refers to light in both literal and figurative senses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太陽|たいよう}の{光|ひかり}: sunlight
- {月|つき}の{光|ひかり}: moonlight
- {光|ひかり}が{当|あ}たる: light shines on
- {光|ひかり}を{放|はな}つ: to emit light
- {希望|きぼう}の{光|ひかり}: ray of hope

RELATED TERMS:
- {光|ひか}る: to shine (verb)
- {明|あか}るい: bright
- {輝|かがや}く: to sparkle
- {日光|にっこう}: sunlight

Note: ひかり is also the name of a Shinkansen line and train series.
